'''Gary Shiu''' (Chinese: {{lang|zh|蕭文禮}}) is a Chinese-American theoretical physicist who is the [[Paul Dirac|Paul Dirac Professor of Physics]] at the [[University of Wisconsin-Madison]].<ref name=":dirac"/> His research spans cosmology, particle physics, and string theory. He has made significant contributions to both fundamental and phenomenological aspects of string theory. He is well known for his work in constructing models of particle physics and cosmology from string theory, and in elucidating experimental and observational consequences of fundamental physics. He brought string theory research to the University of Wisconsin-Madison and was involved in the founding of the Theoretical and Computational Cosmology Group and the AI ∩ Universe Initiative.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://shiu.physics.wisc.edu/bio |title= Bio |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Physics Department |publisher= [[University of Wisconsin-Madison]]|access-date= 8 August 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref>

==Education==
Gary Shiu received his primary and secondary school education at [[St Joseph's College, Hong Kong|St Joseph's College]]. He received a bachelor's of science in physics from the [[Chinese University of Hong Kong]] in 1993<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.alumni.cuhk.edu.hk/magazine/202109/pdf/CUAM_202109_03-06.pdf |title= 威斯康辛大學蕭文禮教授心繫香港科研發展: 帶領學生參與國際頂級研究|author= <!--Not stated--> |date= September 2021 |website= |publisher= [[Chinese University of Hong Kong]] |access-date= 26 July 2023 |quote= |language= Chinese}}</ref> and a Ph.D. from [[Cornell University]] in 1998 under advisor [[Henry Tye]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.classe.cornell.edu/Research/ParticleTheory/TheoryStudents.html |title= Cornell Particle Theory Graduate Students |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Cornell Laboratory for Accelerator-based Sciences and Education |publisher= [[Cornell University]] |access-date= 26 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.aip.org/history-programs/niels-bohr-library/oral-histories/47146 |title= Oral History: Henry Tye |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 26 February 2021 |website= [[American Institute of Physics]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref>

==Career==
He conducted postdoctoral research work at [[C. N. Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics]] and subsequently at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] before joining the faculty of the University of Wisconsin-Madison in the United States. He was a senior fellow at the Hong Kong Institute for Advanced Study<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.apctp.org/theme/d/html/activities/activities01_read.php?id=788&page=3 |title= Scientific Programs |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Asia Pacific Center for Theoretical Physics |publisher= |access-date= 28 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://ias.ust.hk/workshop/cosmology/2014/organizers.html |title= Organizers |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Jockey Club Institute for Advanced Study |publisher= [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]] |access-date= 28 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref> and the founding director of the Center for Fundamental Physics and concurrently chair professor of physics at the [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]] in Hong Kong.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.scmp.com/lifestyle/technology/article/1330321/physicist-recalls-witnessing-higgs-particles-discovery-cern |title= Physicist recalls witnessing Higgs particle's discovery at CERN |author= Gary Shiu |date= 14 October 2013 |website= [[South China Morning Post]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://ias.hkust.edu.hk/events/what-is-the-higgs-boson |title= What is the Higgs Boson? |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 2013 |website= |publisher= [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]] |access-date= 26 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref>

He has held visiting professorships at the [[Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics]], [[Stanford University]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://ias.hkust.edu.hk/people/ias-members/alumni/prof-gary-shiu |title= Prof. Gary SHIU: 蕭文禮教授 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref> [[University of Amsterdam]], and the [[Kavli Institute for the Physics and Mathematics of the Universe]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://db.ipmu.jp/member/memberphotoen.html |title= People (long directory) |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Kavli Institute for the Physics and Mathematics of the Universe]]  |publisher= |access-date= 28 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://db.ipmu.jp/member/personal/1241en.html |title= People (Gary Shiu) |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Kavli Institute for the Physics and Mathematics of the Universe]] |publisher= |access-date= 28 July 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref> Shiu has given numerous lectures worldwide, both at a
